correctness.rationale: Every private leaf copies its core state at each update. A clique vertex sees S−x_i+y_i ones out of m neighbors. For m=2k this yields three branches x′=0 if S<k, x′=y if S=k, x′=1 if S>k; paired balanced words give c² recurrent states plus 2 homogeneous states. The other first-entry classes partition by whether x is homogeneous and whether the next core is balanced, homogeneous, or intermediate, giving D1=2(2^m−1), D3=c(2^m−c−2). For m=2k+1, borderline outputs are (1−x)∧y at S=k or (1−x)∨y at S=k+1; disjointness/complement-cover forces only recurrent balanced-border pairs, 2c(k+2) plus 2 homogeneous states, and their free leaf-bit multiplicities yield D1 and D3. D2 is the nonnegative complement of the partition. Stirling's central binomial estimate gives even recurrence fraction 2/(πm) and odd 2^(−m)√(2m/π). Fresh independent direct-neighborhood orbit enumeration for m=3..7 (21,824 labelled states) matched exact formulas, including m=3 depth vector (20,32,12,0), m=5 (82,302,400,240), m=6 (402,126,2728,840), and fixed counts. All-order proof comes from the branch partition, not finite checks.
